faqs.question: Is Dynamics 365 Business Central suitable for small businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's designed to scale with your business—from startups to mid-sized enterprises.

faqs.question: Can I migrate from my existing ERP to Business Central?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our team provides end-to-end migration services with minimal downtime.

faqs.question: Is Dynamics 365 Business Central secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, it leverages Microsoft Azure's robust security protocols and compliance standards.

faqs.question: Is Business Central available on cloud or on-premises?
faqs.answer: Yes, Business Central is available in both cloud and on-premises versions.

faqs.question: Can Business Central integrate with other applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. Business Central integrates easily with Microsoft 365, Power BI, Power Apps, third-party tools, and industry-specific applications through APIs.
